title: FaceTape
overview: A junkie decides to come clean from abusing an analog VR drug called FaceTape only to find his life outside of his addiction is far from stable.

title: The Wronged of Juiced
overview: Gus sees a boy drinking juice. It is not the same as he remembers.

title: Robbed
overview: When a man falls into temptation and joins a robbery that goes terribly wrong, he descends into paranoia and tries to get rid of the money he believes is cursed.

title: Pouramika
overview: A poetry short film

title: National Theatre at Home: Pride
overview: Summer 1984. The UK is in turmoil. With Thatcher battling to dismantle the coal industry, and a lethal pandemic on the rise, 24-year-old activist Mark Ashton founds an unlikely new alliance with the pit communities of South Wales: Lesbians and Gays Support the Miners. Funny, fierce and filled with joy, what follows is the incredible true story of two disparate communities joining forces – and making history. This brand-new musical unites Matthew Warchus and Stephen Beresford, director and writer of the hit film Pride, with composers Christopher Nightingale, Josh Cohen, and DJ Walde. Together they share the inspiring story of these real-life events, featuring original songs inspired by protest anthems, pop, rock, disco and the Welsh choral tradition.

title: Traços de Fuga
overview: Diana retreats into drawing and music to escape the chaos of her home. Each page of her notebook becomes an extension of the emotions she cannot bring herself to say out loud. But when even the smallest moments of peace are interrupted, Diana realizes that mentally escaping may no longer be enough to cope with the reality she lives in.

title: Plankgas
overview: After taking a detour on a deserted road, a professional entertainer is pursued by a menacing pick-up truck and must outsmart its relentless driver to survive.

title: SHE
overview: Liva, a young woman, is cleaning up after her and her late twin sister's 21st birthday, when she suddenly starts to hear strange sounds. She starts to investigate, but what she stumbles upon turns her birthday into her own personal hell.

title: Goodbye Eri The Fan Film Live Action
overview: Yago, following a personal request from his ailing mother, begins to document his life through recordings. This film project takes an unexpected turn when it becomes intertwined with a mysterious figure named Eri, exploring the fine line between reality and fiction whilst grappling with grief and artistic creation.

title: THE APE OF GOD
overview: A happening that connects perspectives of lost souls discovering a mysterious chain of voyeurism and obsession, that leads them to encounter the devil.

title: Ramayana: Rise of a Legend
overview: An ancient epic follows a young prince and princess whose marriage and subsequent exile mark the beginning of a legendary journey. Their story of love, duty and destiny sets the stage for greater challenges ahead.

title: Wild Horse Nine
overview: Shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup, CIA agents Chris and Lee are dispatched from Santiago to Easter Island by their bureau chief, MJ. Amongst the Island's iconic statues, and as the longtime partners wrestle with their dark pasts and present conspiracies, Chris's newfound bond with a pair of rebellious students threatens to send everyone’s trip to this remote paradise sideways.

title: Bitter Christmas
overview: During a long December holiday weekend, a woman, whose mother has recently died, throws herself into work as a form of escape. Her relentless pace is interrupted when a panic attack forces her to take a break.

title: Blue Lights
overview: Alejandro's 70th birthday unveils tensions and secrets within his gay/lesbian friend circle. Relationships evolve as truths about love, loss, and societal shifts emerge, exploring complexities that bind people together.

title: Four Minus Three
overview: Barbara and her partner Heli are professional clowns, living out their dream of an alternative, joy filled life with their two children, laughing at what doesn't work out. But when a tragic car accident takes Heli and the children, Barbara is left alone. In the face of unspeakable loss, her belief in humor, hope, and humanity is put to the ultimate test. Can her way of seeing the world — through both its light and shadow — help her find a way back to life? She bets she'll laugh again.

title: Godzilla Minus Zero
overview: War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life. Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant. There is no third time. Everything ends here.

title: Chili Finger
overview: When a small town lawyer discovers a severed finger in her chili, she blackmails the restaurant for a cash payout in an effort to regain control over her mundane life. The situation quickly spirals out of control, and her life descends into chaos.

title: Charlie vs. the Chocolate Factory
overview: Years after his famous candy contest, Willy Wonka returns to his factory, where a new wave of "rotten" kids is plotting to nab a priceless chocolate bar.

title: Under the City Lights
overview: The story of two friends, a boy and a girl, finding more about each other during their long walks around Rome.

title: National Theatre Live: Golden Boy
overview: Josh O’Connor (The Crown; Challengers) leads the cast in this searing revival of Clifford Odets’ knockout American classic.  1930s New York, at the height of the Depression. Joe Bonaparte is a gifted young violinist with a future in music, until a chance at fame and fortune lures him into the brutal world of professional boxing. He must confront what he’s willing to sacrifice, who he’s willing to become and how to find his place in a world that demands he choose a side.  Brought to life with a live string quartet and filmed live from the Almeida Theatre, Olivier Award-winner Sam Yates (Vanya) directs this propulsive drama exploring ambition, identity, and the high price of success.

title: Kathanar - The Wild Sorcerer
overview: Based on the tales of Kadamattathu Kathanar, the legendary priest who is believed to have lived in Kadamattom and possessed supernatural powers.

title: 7G Rainbow Colony 2
overview: Nearly 10 years post the tragic death of Anitha, Kathir's ailing mother makes desperate attempts to get him settled after sensing his attraction to the daughter of Flat No.7G's Newest Tenant.

title: Arasan
overview: Taking place as an untold story in the same world as Vetrimaaran's Vadachennai, a man holds a struggling, dark past in the 1990s.

title: Untitled Abbott Le-Eldred Film
overview: No details have been provided for this film yet.

title: Kenan & Kel Meet Frankenstein
overview: Two delivery drivers' routine drop-off takes a terrifying turn when they arrive at a creepy, out-of-place castle and accidentally awaken Frankenstein’s monster — turning an ordinary night into a fight for survival

title: In search of the Griffin
overview: It seems to me that the image of the griffin in my film represents something mythical, something ancient that once existed but which we have forgotten how to see and believe in. In this sense, the Griffin stands on the same level as the myth of Revolution and Love. And I would like to prove to everyone, just as I proved the existence of the Griffin in my dream, that true love and revolution—a change in the world order—are still possible despite the challenges ahead.

title: The Wayans Bros. Reunion
overview: Join Shawn Wayans, Marlon Wayans, and Anna Maria Horsford for a fast‑paced and laugh‑filled night celebrating the sitcom that ran for five seasons and became one of the most memorable comedy series of the 90s. This special takes a look at the show’s origin and evolution through candid interviews with the cast and original directors, featuring classic clips, behind‑the‑scenes stories, and the brothers’ unfiltered commentary on how their unique comedic style shaped every episode. Packed with never‑before‑seen moments and genuine reflections, the reunion highlights everything fans loved about The Wayans Bros. while staying true to the show’s signature humor and energy.

title: Margie Claus
overview: When Santa goes missing Christmas Eve, his wife Margie Claus has to assemble a rag-tag team of long-retired reindeer to rescue Santa and save Christmas

title: Carnaval
overview: Four friends from Brabant who live for Carnaval see their party plans unravel when one of them suddenly has to care for his estranged daughter and Prince Carnaval reveals a sinister side. They must do everything they can to save Carnaval.

title: Queen at Sea
overview: As advanced dementia erodes an older woman's ability to communicate her inner life, her husband and daughter struggle to act in her best interests, navigating love and the fragile boundaries between care, protection and autonomy.

title: Hope
overview: In the remote South Korean village of Hope Harbor, police chief Bum-seok and officer Sung-ae are called to investigate a mysterious creature wreaking havoc on the community. But all is not as it seems, and perceptions can be misleading. What begins as ignorance plants the seed of disaster, escalating through human conflict into a tragedy of cosmic proportions.

title: Hen
overview: Escaping from a chicken farm, a hen finds refuge in the courtyard of a crumbling restaurant. There, she discovers love, confronts the pecking order, and fights to protect her eggs from a greedy owner. Her droll yet touching quest for motherhood mirrors the messy compromises and silent struggles of human lives.

title: Salvation
overview: In a remote village, an exiled clan returns, reviving a decades-old land feud. Seized by divine visions, Mesut challenges his brother’s leadership to save his people. Will this new path bring salvation or tragedy?

title: How to Rob a Bank
overview: A crew of social media-savvy bank robbers broadcasts their daring heists, unaware that their growing viral fame has put them in the crosshairs of a veteran FBI agent and a brilliant software engineer. Despite the unlikely duo closing in, the crime ring pushes past their limits, putting everything on the line for their most ambitious heist yet.

title: The Only Living Pickpocket in New York
overview: Harry Lehman is an aging pickpocket who plies his trade with ever-diminishing returns in a drastically changed New York. Wallets stuffed with cash have been replaced by easily cancelled credit cards, and Harry struggles to make ends meet as he cares for his disabled wife, Rosie. When he unwittingly purloins and fences a valuable USB stick, Harry finds himself in a race against time to return the loot or face the rage of a vengeful crime family.

title: Ebenezer
overview: An elderly miser embarks on a supernatural journey after visits from the ghost of his former business partner and the Spirits of Christmas Past, Present, and Yet to Come force him to confront his past and fight for a second chance at happiness.

title: Club Kid
overview: A hard-partying New York City club promoter sees his whirlwind lifestyle upended by the arrival of the 10-year-old son he never knew he had.

title: Stand Up
overview: Vera is a fun-loving 23-year-old until her entire life is upended after an accident leaves her in a wheelchair. Struggling to cope with her new reality, she meets Xander, who helps to show her that being in a wheelchair doesn’t mean she’s stuck.

title: Collage
overview: A girl working in a museum tries to convince a colleague that two visitors are flirting. And how does she know? Scientific studies say six signs show one person's attraction to another.

title: BRIDGE -My Little Friends-
overview: "I'll bring Shiro to you. I promise!" Jin, the cat, made this promise to Mugi, who is deeply sad about losing her beloved dog, Shiro. Jin loves Mugi very much and, after hearing the story of the "Rainbow Bridge" from his owner Aki, he decides to take Mugi to meet Shiro at the Rainbow Bridge. Can Jin heal Mugi's sadness? With the help of nearby pigeons and squirrels, Jin's great plan is now underway.

title: The Tower of Strength
overview: A persecuted child finds shelter in the house of the enemy. The host faces an awestruck choice: to save the child's life and his own integrity - or risk losing his family to a group of armed kinsmen.

title: While We Slept
overview: In Prague, two 16-year-old girls, the exuberant Dáša and the reserved Klára, have to deal with the toxic masculinity of two boys their age, Robert and Pavel.

title: Disturbia
overview: Before our very eyes a strange human-bird hybrid undergoes constant transformation to cope with the omnipresent tensions of economical, ideological, military, and climatic threats.

title: The Reach
overview: Stella Flanders is the oldest woman on Goat Island. Throughout her life, she has never crossed the reach that separates the isle from the mainland. She has spent her entire existence in that small, close-knit community that is almost as welcoming as a family and in which she has always had everything she needed. But as a freezing winter descends upon the island, Stella begins to see visions of those she once loved, calling her toward the Reach. Perhaps the time has come for her to embark on that journey she never wished to take.

title: Free Fish
overview: Free Fish is a short documentary filmed over the course of a year in Gaza, following two brothers — Abu Nagham and Ahmad — separated by war yet connected by the sea. Displaced from their home, Abu Nagham now lives in a tent in the south, fishing with his young nephew Rami, who lost his twin brother. Ahmad remains in the north, fishing amid ruins and occupation.  Once a source of livelihood and freedom, the sea has become a battleground — heavily restricted, constantly watched, and always dangerous.

title: Baab
overview: After discovering cassette tapes hidden behind a green door, Wahida begins to unravel the truth about her twin sister's death. Plagued by tinnitus, her journey into the mountains uncovers an unsettling revelation.

title: G.O.A.T.
overview: A tragicomic road trip set in rural Netherlands about unprocessed trauma, miscommunication, and... a goat.

title: Ode (An Acknowledgement of Sea Country)
overview: Ode is a cameraless animation made from handmade macroalgae celluloid. Developed with CSIRO and marine scientists, it uses contact printing, botanicollage, and seaweed bio-sonification to explore post-petrochemical cinema. Lasting 365 seconds, the film offers an ocean-responsive meditation on deep time, material intelligence, and more-than-human collaboration.

title: Wetboy
overview: A summer trip to the river turns into a moment no one saw coming. Beneath the water, a tension arises between two friends, surfacing in the form of shock, anger, and questions neither of them is ready to face.

title: The Last Rehearsal
overview: A beloved acting teacher rallies his favourite students one last time to stage his final play.

title: LUCIE in RÉ
overview: Following the betrayal of her best friend, Lucie finds herself alone on vacation on the Ile de Ré. As she boards the train, her telephone falls on the track. She hesitates, but sets off - adventure is adventure...

title: Light Falling Down
overview: Set near the Treblinka death camp in Nazi-occupied Poland, a reclusive farmwoman risks everything to shelter a young Jewish girl in hiding.

title: Fanny
overview: The ambitious hairdresser Fanny must survive within the demanding world of the Viennese court. When she pays no mind to the existing rules and moralities of the time, she draws the unexpected attention of the Empress, as well as a public audience.

title: The Fountain
overview: After losing her parents, 11-year-old Mila moves in with her grandparents. As she adjusts to her new life, a walk in the forest with her grandfather leads to a mystical fountain, which sets her on a journey of healing and belief.

title: Yr Wyddfa
overview: An estranged father and daughter climb Yr Wyddfa together. Along the way, it becomes clear why they haven't talked to each other for so long and what occasion brings them together today.

title: Veil of Silence
overview: A crumbling relationship where two people are too afraid to face their problems. Gemma silently drifts through her inner world, where her ego confronts her.

title: Cyclus
overview: Lisa and Marit communicate through a tape. Cyclus explores the subtle red flags of partner abuse (in teenage lives), based on the glorification of romantic ups & downs in modern media.

title: Walk In The Park
overview: Mark and Evelien are the young parents of a very healthy son. Ten fingers, ten toes, all the trimmings, but the sunny outlook is missing. In a world where appearances rule, they have forgotten reality. Life and love are not always fun and the grind lurks like a predator. During eight uncomfortable walks, they try to find out where they took the wrong turn and whether it is even possible to end up on the right path next to each other.

title: Puma Matriarchs of Torres Del Paine
overview: The film chronicles the lives of three mother Pumas (aka Mountain Lions, Cougars) as they survive and thrive in the rugged terrain of Chilean Patagonia. These three matriarchs, Sarmiento, Rupestra and Petaca, drive the dynamics of living and dominating their respective territories. Raising their kits, teaching them how to catch prey and hunting that prey increase these cats’ chances of surviving in this beautiful but challenging habitat.

title: Buskers of Porto
overview: "Buskers of Porto" shows how the city and its musicians are intertwined. The documentary is a journey through the streets of Porto and along the many street musicians that enrich this city with their music. They share intimate stories about their work on the streets and the freedom they experience, but also about the challenges that it brings along with it. "Buskers of Porto" is a connecting film about music, dreams, and survival.

title: Known Strangers
overview: Three former classmates unexpectedly run into each other during a diner robbery. An awkward reunion between a criminal, a police officer, and a diner employee, as they are faced with the different life paths that have led them there.

title: Somewhere Between Here and There
overview: When Mia finds herself at her own wake, dead but not quite gone, she must uncover what’s keeping her tethered and what it truly means to let go.

title: Lotus
overview: A breast cancer survivor is being manipulated by male doctors into undergoing breast implant surgery. Confused by these manipulations, she decides to have breast surgery. In the waiting room of the plastic surgeon's office, she visits with her husband, and the universe will send her a message.

title: Summer
overview: Every summer, Francesca (12, Italian) spends time with her Dutch friend Alice (14) in her small Italian village. However, this year something seems to have changed. Alice is different. Older. She is more interested in making friends with the older and seemingly cooler kids in the village, and Francesca feels that they are drifting apart. Whilst Francesca still embraces her childhood, Alice is on the verge of becoming a teenager.

title: The Boy With The Balloon Heart
overview: Born with a balloon heart, a wide-eyed, dreamy and emotional boy drifts through life, never quite able to find where he belongs. His delicate, floating heart sets him apart—both a gift and a burden in a world that values groundedness, practicality and conformity. As he stumbles through life grappling against the weight of existence, he struggles with loneliness and the bane of being different. But one day, a quiet revelation shows him that what once felt like a flaw might be the very thing that sets him free.

title: The Border Czar
overview: After delivering a rousing speech on immigration, Rep. Jim Coolidge goes to sleep - only to wake up on the wrong side of the border.

title: Bystander
overview: Across a series of everyday settings - a bus stop late at night, a locker room after a match, an online gaming session, an open-plan office - we witness subtle but recognisable moments of harassment and boundary-crossing behaviour directed towards women. Nothing heightened. Nothing dramatised beyond reality. Just the familiar discomfort of something not quite right.

title: Faceless People - The Journey of Sri Lankan Tamil Refugees in India
overview: Six Sri Lankan Tamil refugees living in India, from different age groups, speak about their life in camps, and their hopes and aspirations. For over three decades, Sri Lankan Tamil refugees have lived in Tamil Nadu in a protracted situation—without certainty about their future and without viable policy solutions. Three generations have grown up with aspirations they cannot fulfil, surviving through sheer resilience while quietly contributing to the economy of their host communities.

title: Em & Selma Go Griffin Hunting
overview: In the Depression-ravaged countryside of 1930s America, adolescent girls are expected to fulfill a long-standing rite in which they hunt and slay a mythical beast of their mother’s choosing.

title: Waterlanders
overview: In a flood-ravaged Netherlands. A father and his teenage daughter survive in isolation aboard an off-grid ship, cut off from a world shaped by floods & war. When a shellshocked soldier appears, claiming peace has returned, the father faces an impossible choice: trust a stranger and risk everything ... or protect his daughter at the cost of his humanity.

title: Dear Lara
overview: Unveiling abuse in classical music's elite institutions — violinist Lara St. John fights for justice, exposing complicity and systemic misogyny.

title: Todd & The Toad
overview: Anxious, awkward, and terminally avoidant, Todd is a man paralyzed by social anxiety. When pressure mounts from Polly—a girl he’s been messaging online—to finally meet in person, Todd spirals into neurotic panic. To cope with this, he find’s a hint in the darknet, that takes him to lick a mysterious toad... only to awaken in a bizarre therapy session with Juan Carlos (aka JC)—a charismatic, hallucination-induced psychologist claiming to be part of Todd's “corrective experience.”

title: Gnocchi
overview: After an embarrassing mispronunciation of the word “gnocchi”, Emma decides to leave society behind and start a self-sufficient life in the woods, but even there, her obsession continues to haunt her.

title: Grace
overview: Grace is a poignant coming of age drama centered on a woman in her late 20s with Down Syndrome, navigating the complexities of adulthood, independence and first love from within a residential support house. When Grace pushes the boundaries set for her, the consequences ripple through her carefully managed world.

title: Codes
overview: Following a major attack on British soil, a politician discovers the only way of saving his country is by killing the man in front of him.

title: Beautiful Birds
overview: When a widowed birdwatcher reluctantly teams up with her granddaughter for a local birdwatching competition on an island in Scotland, their search for rare species becomes a heartfelt journey through grief, love, and letting go.

title: Against The Clock
overview: Two brothers on the hunt. One man racing against time. Which one will get what they need first?

title: When I Was Little, I Wasn't Afraid
overview: In the buzzing chaos of Rotterdam-IJsselmonde, 10-year-old Gush runs into a strange neighbor: a future version of himself, lost in stories that might just change everything.

title: Invisible Injuries
overview: After war, Australian veteran Andy Fermo returned home carrying invisible wounds. Invisible Injuries explores PTSD's impact on identity, family and daily life, and the courage it takes to heal, reconnect and keep moving forward.

title: Halima - How to Stay Strong
overview: Halima underwent an operation to reconstruct her vulva after female genital mutilation. On her journey home, she talks about her way of staying strong. A film about the consequences of FGM, everyday racism in Germany and reality as a female refugee.  Halima is a collective figure, representing biography, struggle and point of view of five somali women, who had suffred from FGM/C and worked on the film in all stages of production.

title: Janet's Island
overview: During their holiday, two little girls help Janet, a heartbroken English traveller—unaware that this encounter will jeopardise their own family

title: D!SoRd3rEd
overview: In a wasteland of rubble and ruin, J. Doe—a Black Patient Zero—navigates the wreckage of a nation haunted by its own reflection. Pursued by histories of violence, erasure, and resistance, he confronts the ghosts of an unfinished reckoning. Blurring archive and hallucination, Disordered is a visual requiem—part ritual, part rupture—that confronts the consequences of a soul that cannot forget, yet refuses to remember its past.

title: Murderers
overview: Ignored by history for 40 years, the Oversteegen sisters' true story inspires "Murderers" (1941-1990). Two teenage girls lure a Nazi to his death. Echoing the psychological trauma of war, emigration, and today's chilling winds of fascism, the film asks: what is the true price of murder for a righteous cause, and what remains of our humanity after we are forced to cross the ultimate line?

title: Friends With Benefits
overview: Two former coworkers lose their insurance and decide couples therapy is a budget-friendly option

title: Knocked Cold
overview: Thian 'Tarzan' de Vries is a young kickboxing sensation from the Netherlands who is rapidly conquering the international fight scene. Behind his invincible image, however, lies a turbulent past marked by addiction, crime, and time spent in youth detention. Kickboxing became both his escape and his salvation. As Thian rises through the ranks toward global recognition, an unease grows beneath the surface: can he keep control when the system that protects him begins to crack?

title: Fido
overview: A young girl watches an old dog. Taking the dog on a walk, a rough encounter with a bully has dire consequences.

title: Bubbles
overview: A forty-year-old woman floats in a relationship bubble until she realizes it is too late.

title: The One Who Draws Dance
overview: Edgar draws dancers in Amsterdam. Everyone knows him.

title: What We Carry
overview: May and Sultan struggle to live within a home consumed by silence after a devastating loss alters their relationship forever. While Sultan clings to hope and the possibility of moving forward, May endures relentless physical pain and carries a secret she cannot bring herself to reveal. As the distance between them grows, old suspicions resurface, and the burden she bears begins to fracture the fragile foundation of their marriage.

title: The Toast Trip
overview: A film about a mind-numbing job, delicious food, absurd numbers, big dreams, death, and toast.

title: Don't Call Me Chef
overview: Clotaire Poirier is not your typical chef. A globetrotter and polyglot, he rose to prominence with French audiences as a finalist on "Top Chef", embodying a new generation of cooks for whom performance no longer comes at the expense of people.

title: Machines Learning
overview: In a dark factory, a bullying worker pushes his crew of robots harder and harder. They observe. They learn. And eventually, they act. The machines are learning, but what are we teaching them?

title: Ethos of Mizoram
overview: Mizoram unfolds as a land where mist-covered hills, close-knit tribes, and an enduring spirit of community shape every aspect of life. This documentary journeys into the heart of Mizo society, exploring the guiding ethos of tlawmngaihna—the tradition of selflessness, courage, discipline, and service to others.

title: The Phenomenon of Presence
overview: The architect of a virtual world called Presence is interviewed about its profound capabilities – it can trigger lucidity in Alzheimer's patients. Meanwhile, inside Presence, a daughter tries to reconnect with her mother, an Alzheimer's sufferer, and bring her back to the physical world.

title: The Boot Room
overview: A junior footballer navigates the brutal hierarchy of a 1988 professional football club steeped in a culture of systemic bullying . His growing unease culminates in a hesitant act of defiance sparking a brutal backlash, turning the violence directly onto him.

title: sometimes, I... - The Breakdown
overview: A breakdown of every aspect of the production of the short film 'Sometimes, I...'

title: Разыскивается Дед Мороз
overview: On New Year's Eve, a not-so-lucky thief, Misha, breaks into a house in the very center of Moscow, where a lonely old man lives. Misha hopes to improve his unenviable financial situation and bring back his family - his wife and seven-year-old daughter. However, in the old man's big house, he finds nothing of any value, except for the deposits of children's toys in the basement. The old man himself assures him that he is none other than the real Father Frost.

title: Spinoza
overview: In 1656 Amsterdam, young Jewish philosopher Bento de Spinoza watches his world collapse when his closest friend is executed for printing forbidden ideas. The city is gripped by plague, fear, and religious zeal, and Bento's growing habit of questioning sacred truths makes him a danger to both Church and synagogue. Amid this turmoil, he meets Rembrandt van Rijn, the once-celebrated painter now sliding into debt and disgrace.

title: Keluarga Tak Berencana
overview: Plot Unknown.

title: Pretty Boy
overview: It's easy to be a pretty boy, but it's not easy to love one

title: The Hunger Games Series
overview: The Hunger Games is a dystopian science-fiction film series based on the novels by Suzanne Collins. Set in the ruined nation of Panem, the story follows young "tributes" forced to fight to the death in a televised arena. The saga follows heroine Katniss Everdeen as she sparks a national rebellion against the oppressive Capitol.

title: How To Become A Flight Attendant
overview: How To Become A Flight Attendant is a American biography which features American Actress Alana Spence and the rest of the cast from The First Class Cadet.

title: THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH
overview: Eight years after the events of Once Upon a Time in... Hollywood, Cliff Booth returns to a changing Los Angeles. Now working as a fixer in the shadows of the Hollywood studio system, Cliff finds himself entangled in a dangerous web of secrets, crimes and betrayals that will test everything he knows about loyalty and survival.

title: The Sparkle Switch
overview: "Get ready to sing, dance, and completely lose your mind! From the studio that brought you the massive theatrical smash hit comes The Sparkle Switch, a non-stop, high-octane musical ride that is taking over the world!

title: Fogaréu
overview: On the border between the real and the fantastic, between the colonial past and the overwhelming modernity of agribusiness, the city of Goiás is the scene of the meeting between the young Fernanda and her secret roots. She returns to the home of her wealthy uncle, after the death of her adoptive mother, in order to implode the certainties and to reveal the painful truth about its origin.

title: Minotaur
overview: When Gleb, a successful company director, finds himself under siege from mounting corporate pressures, an increasingly unstable world, and the discovery of his wife's affair, the collapse of his carefully ordered life accelerates toward violence.

title: Nagi Notes
overview: Yoriko, an artist living in rural Nagi, is haunted by a former love affair she cannot bear to mourn. When Yuri, a recently separated architect, travels from Tokyo to visit her friend and former sister-in-law, both women find themselves at a crossroad, each searching for ways to let go of the past and define their identities. Yuri's brief escape from the city settles into a quiet confrontation of loss and probing for the two women in bucolic Nagi.

title: Plastic Guns
overview: A standoff reveals unsettling truths for an old cowboy.

title: Eureka or (The Quest for Nothing)
overview: A lonely surfer sets out to find the holy grail.

title: Kyle and Eric's Quest for the Golden Bong
overview: Two stoners go on an epic journey, filled with trials and challanges after finding a scroll that tells of a legendary lost artifact

title: Economy-Man: Black Friday
overview: Distraught with emotion after letting Mr. Knoflick destroy half the universe, Economy-Man sits at a crossroads, knowing he must stop Knoflick before the entire economy is destroyed but searching for a team who can help him beat this seemingly unassailable foe. Meanwhile, three other lost heroes lives intersect with his: Loggo, searching for his best friend, who thinks he is dead; Fry-Man, grieving after giving up the mask after the tragic death of his girlfriend, Gwel; and Bob the Soap, a once proud warrior who finds himself lonelier than ever. The four heroes, shrouded with loneliness, will band together to stop Knoflick from destroying the economy, but can they defeat him and his army before it's too late? The entire Economy-Man saga has led to this.

title: CIRCA 1919: A Hollywood Murder
overview: On the production of the first western epic, a story-hungry journalist gets her break when a "prop gun" kills an actor.
